يحترفون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَرِفُونَ (yaḥtarifūna) /jaħ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# يُحْتَرَفُونَ (yuḥtarafūna) /juħ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
